in_sanskrit.name: लोपमुद्रा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: लोपः स्वादिष्टम् (Lopaḥ svādiṣṭam) – Delighting, मुद्रा (mudrā) – loom

in_marathi.name: Lopamudra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fertile, Abounding in Water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lopamudra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lopamudra is a celestial nymph who is said to have been the wife of the sage Agastya. She is described as a beautiful, fertile woman who abounds in water, and is often depicted carrying a jug or standing near a river.

vedic_reference.note: Lopamudra was a courtesan of ancient India. She is best known for her role as the protagonist in the epic Mahabharata. She was a great scholar and was the wife of King Yudhishthira. Lopamudra is also known for her wisdom and her knowledge of the Vedas.
